name: Accordion
description: Zero-jank dynamic height disclosure using CSS Grid 0fr to 1fr interpolation with morphing plus/minus icon and clean theme elevation.

props.name: mode
props.label: Expansion Mode
props.description: Single auto-collapses previous items; multiple allows independent toggles.

props.name: collapsible
props.label: Collapsible
props.description: In single mode, allows closing the currently expanded item.

props.name: gap
props.label: Item Gap (px)
props.description: Spacing between accordion items. 0 forms a seamless connected panel.

props.name: bordered
props.label: Bordered
props.description: Render items with crisp theme borders and active accent rings.

props.name: shadow
props.label: Shadow Elevation
props.description: Apply subtle depth shadow and hover elevation.

props.name: showNumbers
props.label: Index Badges
props.description: Display leading monospace index numbers (01, 02) before titles.

props.name: showIcon
props.label: Morphing Icon
props.description: Signature dual-bar kinetic plus/minus counter-rotating icon.

props.name: duration
props.label: Duration (ms)
props.description: CSS Grid height and icon rotation transition speed in milliseconds.

wordpress.code:
{
  "$schema": "https://schemas.wp.org/trunk/block.json",
  "apiVersion": 3,
  "name": "exhuma/accordion",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "title": "Exhuma Accordion",
  "category": "design",
  "description": "Zero-jank dynamic height disclosure with CSS Grid 0fr/1fr interpolation and morphing plus/minus icon.",
  "attributes": {
    "mode": { "type": "string", "default": "single" },
    "collapsible": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "gap": { "type": "number", "default": 12 },
    "bordered": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "shadow": { "type": "boolean", "default": true },
    "duration": { "type": "number", "default": 300 }
  },
  "viewScript": "file:./view.js",
  "render": "file:./render.php"
}
